question: A train 240 m long is running at a speed of 88 km/h. In what time will it pass a man who is running at a speed of 16 km/h in the same direction?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Relative speed = Speed of train − Speed of man = 88 − 16 = 72 km/h.

Speed in m/s = 72 × (5 ÷ 18) = 20 m/s.

Time taken = Train Length ÷ Relative speed = 240 ÷ 20 = 12 seconds.

**∴ The correct answer is 12 seconds.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Length of the train (L) = 240 m

Speed of the train (VT) = 88 km/h

Speed of the man (VM) = 16 km/h

Direction of movement = Same direction

**Formula Used:**

Relative Speed (same direction) = VT − VM

Distance covered to pass a man = Length of the train

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

 
• 
 
 
 Train (240 m)
 
 
•

• 
 Man

 16 km/h

 Relative Speed = 88 − 16 = 72 km/h

**Calculations:**

⇒ Relative Speed = 88 − 16 = 72 km/h

⇒ Converting km/h to m/s: Relative Speed = 72 × (5 ÷ 18) = 20 m/s

⇒ Total distance to be covered = 240 m

⇒ Time required = 240 ÷ 20

⇒ Time required = 12 seconds

**∴ The correct answer is 12 seconds.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed (Same Direction)

When two objects move in the same direction, their relative speed is the difference of their individual speeds (S₁ − S₂).

Relative Speed (Opposite Direction)

When two objects move in opposite directions, their relative speed is the sum of their individual speeds (S₁ + S₂).

Speed Conversion Factor

To convert km/h to m/s, multiply the speed by 5 ÷ 18. Conversely, to convert m/s to km/h, multiply by 18 ÷ 5.

Distance Covered while Passing

When a train passes a point-sized object (like a man, pole, or tree), the distance covered is exactly equal to the length of the train.
